bestPriceGuarantee.title: Best Price Guarantee
bestPriceGuarantee.intro: We believe you should always get the best deal. If you find a lower price for the same operator, route, and departure date on another platform within 24 hours of booking, we'll credit the difference as a Gilibali voucher.
bestPriceGuarantee.step1: Book your trip on Gilibali as usual.
bestPriceGuarantee.step2: If you spot a lower price elsewhere for the identical sailing, take a screenshot showing the operator name, route, date, and total price.
bestPriceGuarantee.step3: Contact us within 24 hours of your booking via WhatsApp (+62 812 3456 7890) or email (support@gilijet.com) with the screenshot and your booking reference.
bestPriceGuarantee.step4: We'll verify the price within one business day. If it matches, we'll credit the difference to your Gilibali account as a voucher for your next trip.
bestPriceGuarantee.term1: The competing price must be publicly listed and bookable by the general public (no member-only or agent-only rates).
bestPriceGuarantee.term2: The comparison is on the total fare per passenger in IDR, including any booking fees.
bestPriceGuarantee.term3: Voucher credit is capped at Rp 50,000 or 20% of the original fare, whichever is lower.
bestPriceGuarantee.term4: Cannot be combined with promotional codes or group discounts.
bestPriceGuarantee.term5: Gilibali reserves the right to modify or discontinue this guarantee at any time.
